text: In cohesive homotopy type theory, the shape modality ∫ sends a cohesive type to:
choices: its fundamental ∞-groupoid (the 'homotopy type' of the space)
explanation: ∫A (shape of A) is the underlying homotopy type: it collapses connected components to points and forgets the geometric/cohesive structure. ♭A gives the discrete reflection, ♯A gives the codiscrete.
